author: KEXP
description: Liverpool band Ladytron continue to hypnotize audiences with their electro-pop grooves. In our latest Live on KEXP session, the group set fire to the studio with a performance of "Destroy Everything You Touch" and more.
title: Ladytron performs "Destroy Everything You Touch" & more Live on KEXP
